text.en: Pet owners emphasize that walker Lori treats dogs like family, providing loving attention to high-energy pups, reactive companions, and even cats or exotic pets. Clients report that their animals genuinely look forward to walks, treating her building like a second home and showing excitement whenever pickup time arrives.

Clients describe Lori as sweet, trustworthy, and remarkably reliable when managing busy schedules or stepping in during medical emergencies. Owners appreciate handing over home keys with complete peace of mind, praising her punctuality and dedication to supporting pet parents across downtown Toronto.

Owners report that regular neighborhood pack walks provide excellent exercise and help shy or reactive dogs become more confident around others. Pets return home thoroughly exercised and contented, giving busy owners peace of mind while at work or travelling away from home.

q.en: Does Urban Tail handle pets other than dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that Lori provides dependable cat sitting and care for exotic pets during owner vacations.

q.en: Do owners receive regular updates during walks?

a.en: Clients frequently mention receiving wonderful photo and video updates showing their pets enjoying their outings.

q.en: Can reactive or shy dogs join walks?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that Lori is very patient and kind with shy or reactive dogs, helping them adjust comfortably.
